question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Snug
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Uncomfortable)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Snug"** refers to something that is comfortable, cozy, or warm. It is often used to describe a place or a position that feels secure and pleasant. (आरामदायक)

 
 
• **Example:** She curled up in a snug corner of the sofa with her favorite book.
 
 
 
• **"Uncomfortable"** is the opposite of snug. It means causing discomfort, unease, or a lack of physical or emotional comfort. (असुविधाजनक)
 
 
• **Example:** The wooden chair was so uncomfortable that she couldn't sit for long.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Snug'** is **'Uncomfortable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Uncomfortable)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aromatic** (सुगंधित): Having a pleasant and distinctive smell.

 
 
• **Example:** The kitchen was filled with the aromatic scent of freshly baked cookies.
 
 
 
• **Ample** (प्रचुर): More than enough; plentiful.
 
 
• **Example:** There was ample space in the room for all the guests to move around comfortably.
 
 
 
• **Persistent** (दृढ़): Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action despite difficulties or opposition.
 
 
• **Example:** Her persistent efforts led to her success in the competition.
